dataset.name: ESFire30 v1
dataset.transformation: Inverse of UTM zone 30N + ED50 to WGS 84 (41) + axis order change (2D)

visual_overview.feature_retention: drop-smallest-as-needed: visual overview only, not feature-complete at every zoom

fidelity_candidate.feature_retention: no tile/feature limits and no tiny-polygon reduction at maximum zoom; must be revalidated per zoom before production

pmtiles.selection_contract: geometry_id remains a vector-tile property and joins the separate lookup; MVT numeric feature id is intentionally not used.
